Town website from Wikipedia's Sandwich article. School district and SAU from Wikipedia's List of school districts in New Hampshire (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_school_districts_in_New_Hampshire), a secondary source.

towns.note: Carroll (Twin Mountain) uses the official ballot (SB 2) system: deliberative session February 3, 2026, ballot voting March 10, 2026.
